parameters.content:
## 1 · Which posts — live, 09:00, 17:00, or "typos"
Live: Workflow 2 hands over each new post the moment it lands. 09:00/17:00 are the safety net: every post since the watermark, skipping any Posty already replied to. "typos" is a preview from midnight that posts nothing publicly.

nodes.name: Section — 2 · Look up each QU in Xero

parameters.content:
## 2 · Look up each QU in Xero
One Xero quote lookup per post. Replies in-thread: "isn't in the database" when the QU is not a quote, 🎧 studio hours when the quote names them. If Xero does not answer, nothing is posted, Tara is told, and the posts are re-checked next run. Tara gets a DM every run.

## No new posts
Still DMs Tara, so a quiet run is visibly a quiet run.

## 3 · Advance the watermark
Scheduled runs only. Held when Xero was down, so those posts are checked again.

parameters.name: text
parameters.value: ={{ $json.mode === 'preview' ? 'No project posts to check right now — all quiet. :white_check_mark:' : '*Typo check — ' + $json.dateLabel + '*\nNo new project posts since the last check, so nothing to flag. :white_check_mark:' }}
